# Sprachcaffe

> Sprachcaffe is a global language school offering immersive courses for adults and juniors across multiple destinations including Malta, London, Spain, Canada, and more.

Sprachcaffe specializes in language immersion programs combining classroom instruction with cultural experiences, accommodation, and supervised travel for both young learners and adults. The organization offers flexible learning options including in-person courses, online programs, high school exchanges, and au pair placements across 15+ countries.

## Core Programs

- [Your Perfect Experience Abroad Awaits](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc): Main hub showcasing Sprachcaffe's language courses and study abroad programs globally
- [Book a language course online](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/booking.htm): Online booking system for language courses across Malta, London, Málaga
- [Online Language Courses](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/online-courses.htm): Live interactive online language courses in English, Spanish, German, French

## Adult Language Programs

- [Visit Malta (Adults)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/adults/malta.htm): Adult English language courses in Malta with exam preparation and certificates
- [Visit United Kingdom (Adults)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/adults/england.htm): Adult English language courses in UK with London and Brighton options

## Junior & Teen Programs

- [Visit Malta (12–21 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/malta.htm): Junior English language program in Malta for ages 12–21 with activities
- [Visit United Kingdom (12–17 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/england.htm): Teen English language program in UK featuring London and Brighton locations
- [Visit Spain (14–21 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/spain.htm): Teen Spanish language program in Barcelona and Málaga for ages 14–21
- [Visit Germany (12–21 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/germany.htm): Junior German language program in Frankfurt and Munich for ages 12–21
- [Visit France (13–21 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/france.htm): Teen French language program on French Riviera in Nice for ages 13–21
- [Visit Canada (14–21 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/canada.htm): Teen English language program in Vancouver, Canada for ages 14–21
- [Visit Mexico (14–21 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/mexico.htm): Teen Spanish language program in Playa del Carmen, Mexico for ages 14–21
- [Visit China (15–21 years)](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/juniors/china.htm): Teen Mandarin Chinese language program in Beijing for ages 15–21

## Specialized Programs

- [High School Programme](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/high-school.htm): High school exchange program in USA, Australia, Canada, England with host families
- [Au Pair Programme](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/au-pair.htm): Au pair program combining language courses, host family living, childcare experience
- [Unforgettable Language Trips for Groups](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/groups.htm): Group language trips for schools and student organizations worldwide
- [Supervision with Care & Connection](https://www.sprachcaffe.com/en/uc/supervision.htm): 24/7 supervision and safety protocols for teenage language camp participants
